simple.meaning: עָבַד (ʻâbad) appears 289 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a brother in the family line and as a keeper of sheep.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, beginning at Genesis 2:5. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as birth, family, shepherding, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עָבַד (H5647) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows עָבַד through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: עָבַד (ʻâbad) / H5647 is tracked through Genesis 2:5, Genesis 2:15, Genesis 3:23, Genesis 4:2. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

definitions.short: to work (in any sense); by implication, to serve , till , (causatively) enslave , etc.
